beats.label: S1 · Body on El Capitan
beats.text: ISB agent Kyle Turner is pulled from a ride with his son Caleb to a young woman's body tangled in ropes below El Capitan. He and rookie ranger Naya Vasquez find a bullet wound and a gold X tattoo hinting at something bigger than a fall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the case, the partnership, and the X branding that anchors the drug-ring thread.

beats.label: S1 · Turner's buried grief
beats.text: A meteor shower call to his remarried ex-wife Jill reveals Caleb died six years ago, and a lawyer named Esther Avalos starts pressing Turner about a man named Sean Sanderson who vanished right after. Turner is a wreck holding a badge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Caleb/Sanderson wound that turns out to drive the entire season's real story.

beats.label: S1 · Jane Doe is Lucy Cook
beats.text: A pot-dealer informant is strangled after Turner leans on him about the gold X pills, and the victim is identified as Lucy Cook, a Miwok girl who vanished from the park in 2010 under Turner's own investigation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the case as Turner's cold case coming back, and links Lucy to the branded drug ring.

beats.label: S1 · The mine and the squatter camp
beats.text: Vasquez gets trapped in a hidden mine that Turner digs her out of, cementing their partnership. Inside they find a branded respirator, and a squatter girl confesses Lucy ran pills for a lover called "Terces."
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bridges the drug plot to a specific suspect and locks the Turner–Vasquez bond that carries the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Jill's overdose
beats.text: Vasquez flees LA with her son Gael to escape her ex Michael; the fight at Turner's house pushes Jill to attempt suicide with pills traced back to wildlife manager Shane Maguire. Turner beats Maguire publicly and is suspended.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Vasquez and Gael inside Turner's life and lights the fuse on Maguire, whose exposure unlocks the Caleb truth.

beats.label: S1 · Terces is Maguire
beats.text: Lucy's unlocked phone reveals Maguire as Terces. He shoots Turner in the woods and is about to finish him when Vasquez arrives and kills him, and Jill finally confesses she paid Maguire to kill Sanderson, Caleb's murderer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Caleb mystery, reveals Jill's betrayal, and shows Vasquez has fully replaced Turner as the park's future.

beats.label: S1 · Souter was Lucy's father
beats.text: Turner proves Chief Ranger Paul Souter faked the DNA results because he was Lucy's father, and that he shot her by accident while chasing her after she abducted his granddaughter. Souter kills himself; Turner leaves Vasquez his horse and walks away from the park.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The true killer and the reason for the cover-up, plus Turner's exit and Vasquez's inheritance of his beat.

cliffhanger.text: Turner has solved Lucy's death and learned his ex-wife had their son's killer murdered, and he walks away from Yosemite leaving Vasquez his horse. Whether he can live with any of it, and whether Vasquez can hold the park alone, is left hanging.
questions: Where does Turner go now that the badge and the marriage are both gone?
Can Vasquez, still a rookie, actually carry the ISB beat Turner just vacated?
Does Jill face any consequence for orchestrating Sanderson's murder?

characters.name: Kyle Turner
characters.line: ISB special agent grieving his son Caleb; solves Lucy's murder, learns his ex-wife had the killer killed, and leaves the park.

characters.name: Naya Vasquez
characters.line: Rookie ranger and single mother who fled LA with her son Gael; kills Maguire to save Turner and inherits his horse and his beat.

characters.name: Jill
characters.line: Turner's remarried ex-wife; confesses she paid Shane Maguire to kill Sean Sanderson, the man who murdered their son Caleb.

characters.name: Paul Souter
characters.line: Chief Park Ranger and Turner's mentor; exposed as Lucy's biological father and her accidental killer, he takes his own life.

characters.name: Shane Maguire
characters.line: Wildlife manager unmasked as "Terces," Lucy's lover and the drug ring's inside man; shot dead by Vasquez in the finale.

characters.name: Lucy Cook
characters.line: The Miwok victim, secretly Souter's daughter, whose 2010 disappearance and return to blackmail him triggered the whole case.

characters.name: Gael
characters.line: Vasquez's young son, now living with her in Yosemite after she fled his father Michael in Los Angeles.

characters.name: Esther Avalos
characters.line: Law firm investigator building a wrongful-death suit against the park over Sanderson; Turner has agreed to help her.
